I've restored the sentry.ignore handling in storeJobAnnotation() that I had incorrectly removed. You're right - this tagging is needed to ensure we have consistent error handling across different code paths when runner acquisition fails.

The restored code maintains the use of t.SentryIgnore constant while adding back the key functionality:
- Checks if error message contains "The job was not acquired by" and "even after multiple attempts"
- Adds sentry.ignore=true tag for these specific errors
- Ensures proper error tracking exclusion while still logging to Splunk

This ensures we don't lose error tagging, particularly for the runner acquisition timeout errors that we want to exclude from Sentry tracking. Thanks for catching this - removing the code would have caused inconsistent error reporting.
